scope: Privacy, upgrade semantic drift, PCD statement assumptions and proof/runtime separation; not a formal soundness review of a selected construction

clarifications.finding: Privacy appears as item 9 of the local compliance relation. A single-run relation checking a disclosure policy does not by itself prove relational noninterference or ZK privacy.
clarifications.requested_clarification: Separate single-step disclosure-policy compliance from the relational observation-security theorem; explicitly include errors, fees/costs, network/hosting observations and public commitment links as in-scope or excluded leakage.

clarifications.finding: State/history binding is present, but hidden-state completeness and absence are not explicit. A valid proof over a selected private subset can still omit an outstanding liability or revocation.
clarifications.requested_clarification: Add authenticated state-domain/frame and completeness/nonmembership obligations wherever a claim relies on absence or uniqueness; projection-local None must not stand for global nonexistence.

clarifications.finding: The induction appropriately distinguishes base and recursion, but a future construction must define well-founded history composition and legitimate base provenance precisely.
clarifications.requested_clarification: State whether histories are sequences or DAGs, how acyclicity/progress and branch joins are enforced, and how base resource legitimacy is rooted in actual ledger/external evidence rather than prover-selected state.

clarifications.finding: The evolution rule is correctly intent-preserving, but persistent continuations need the same binding and migration relation as immediate execution.
clarifications.requested_clarification: Require old residual duties, recovery rights, disclosure constraints and resource semantics to survive migration or obtain explicitly authorized amendment. SCU-compatible schemas/interfaces are insufficient evidence.

strengths: Correctly states that boundedness does not imply financial correctness or workflow liveness.
Adversarial witnesses and arbitrary verifier-key substitution are in scope.
Explicitly distinguishes ledger uniqueness/finality from recursive proof verification.
Versions, phase behavior, complete effects and residual duties are bound; no simulated global rollback claimed.
Maintainer approval is excluded from developer program validity.
review_assurance: Source-grounded conceptual review only; no cryptographic scheme/constraint system audited or theorem discharged
